import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    length_num1 = random.randint(1, 200)
    length_num2 = random.randint(1, 200)

    num1 = "".join(random.choice(string.digits) for _ in range(length_num1))
    num2 = "".join(random.choice(string.digits) for _ in range(length_num2))

    # Make sure we do not have any leading zeros, except if the number is 0 itself
    num1 = str(int(num1))
    num2 = str(int(num2))

    return num1, num2
